verses.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
verses.pt: Contra o mal do sussurrador, o absconso

verses.en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind
verses.pt: Que sussurra perfídias nos peitos dos homens

verses.en: From among the jinn and mankind
verses.pt: Seja ele dos jinns, seja ele dos homens
